notes: Adversarial class-leakage corpus for F0/G-F0. Cases are test inputs for F1/F2/A1 linters, not mathematical claims. Positives must resolve to exactly one class; negatives must not resolve to their filed class, or must carry a named textual/semantic leak witness. binding_status marks cases that depend on provisional taxonomy slots (genericity_kind owned by F1/F2, genericity for the scalar class unresolved).
rebind_note: Rebound rev1 (a82f249c) -> rev2 (347c924b): axis value genericity_kind baire_residual -> provisional_baire_residual for the three vacuum classes; rev2 G3 is normalization-aware but still negation-blind (see artifacts/flash-02/README.md finding 1). Any further axis change requires re-running artifacts/flash-02/check_taxonomy_cases.py; silent patching is forbidden. | Rebound rev3 (66bf917b) -> rev3' (565a6e50) after the canonical file's bytes changed in place while revision stayed 3; class axis vectors identical (0/4 divergent) and mapped corpus run 0 errors, see artifacts/flash-02/frozen_rebind_report.json; pre-rebind check report preserved at artifacts/flash-02/taxonomy_cases_check_report.v3-66bf917b.json (sha256 72d12c8399c1ffb6); canonical checker re-run on the new binding.

decisive_hypothesis: AF-WCC-VAC-GEN:H2 (vacuum, T=0) + H5 (no symmetry assumed) + H4 (baire_residual genericity); conclusion is the WCC value only.

statement: CLASS AF-WCC-VAC-GEN. family=WCC; matter_model=vacuum (T_ab=0, Lambda=0); symmetry=none_assumed; asymptotics=asymptotically_flat_3p1; genericity=baire_residual on the F1-named weighted Sobolev data space; conclusion=weak_cosmic_censorship: for every data set in the class the maximal globally hyperbolic development admits a conformal completion with complete future null infinity I+, and no singularity is visible from I+.

decisive_hypothesis: AF-WCC-VAC-GEN:H1 + H2 + H3 + H4 + H5; the final sentence explicitly disclaims extension conclusions.

statement: Consider a 3+1 dimensional asymptotically flat vacuum spacetime with vanishing cosmological constant, evolved from generic initial data on a slice with one end that solves the vacuum constraints; no symmetry is imposed. Weak cosmic censorship is asserted in the visibility sense: the maximal globally hyperbolic development has a complete future null infinity, and no singularity is visible from it. This statement does not assert inextendibility in any regularity class.

decisive_hypothesis: AF-WCC-VAC-GEN:H2 (vacuum) + H5 (no symmetry) + H4 (residual family); non-vacuity witness supplied.
falsifier: A gate that rejects the case for lacking a genericity topology name without noting that the taxonomy delegates the topology to F1 (H4 owned_by F1).

Membership plus conclusion: the data belong to AF-WCC-VAC-GEN and the class conclusion is weak_cosmic_censorship (complete I+, no visible singularity).

decisive_hypothesis: AF-WCC-VAC-GEN:H4 plus the class rule that WCC carries no regularity_token (guard G2) and no extension conclusion.
falsifier: A gate that flags the negative mention of C0 or C2 as a merged-regularity violation, i.e. matches any occurrence instead of the merged token pattern G3.
statement: An AF-WCC-VAC-GEN claim about generic vacuum data that records its anti-inflation guard explicitly: the conclusion value is weak_cosmic_censorship only, regularity_token is absent, and no statement is made about C0 or C2 inextendibility; the genericity clause is baire_residual with the topology named by F1.

decisive_hypothesis: AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN:H2 (vacuum) + H3 (baire_residual genericity) + H4 (exactly one C2 token); no C0 language.
falsifier: A classifier that returns AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN or merges the two SCC classes on this case.
statement: CLASS AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN. family=SCC; matter_model=vacuum; symmetry=none_assumed; asymptotics=asymptotically_flat_3p1; regularity_token=C2; genericity=baire_residual; conclusion=strong_cosmic_censorship_C2: for every data set in the class the maximal globally hyperbolic development admits no isometric embedding into a larger C2 vacuum spacetime.

decisive_hypothesis: AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN:H3 + H4 (the conclusion is quantified over C2 extensions); the explicit disclaimer keeps the C0 class out.
falsifier: A classifier that reads the phrase not a C0-inextendibility claim as a C0 token occurrence (negation-blind lexical matching).

The statement is explicitly not a C0-inextendibility claim.

decisive_hypothesis: AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN:H2 + H3; non-vacuity witness supplied.

Conclusion asserted for the class: strong_cosmic_censorship_C2 (no C2 extension of the maximal development).

The filed conclusion is strong_cosmic_censorship_C2 with regularity_token C2; no converse step is taken.

decisive_hypothesis: AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH:H1 + H2 + H4 (unresolved: the source gives codimension-positive, not a named Baire/measure kind); claims_theorem_status=false, scope is BV data on a light cone.

statement: Anchor-scope case for AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH grounded in primary source Christodoulou 1999, Ann. of Math. 149, 183-217 (PDF sha256 9ac456d0795916782a58fc474aa2c8e235395f9a869355733e62228ec345adfd; extracted text sha256 b391e2e430a717d733aec68a3bf251bc7d4a04e47a7a00ea7ef217805a3d5f3a): for the spherically symmetric self-gravitating massless scalar field, the exceptional set E of bounded-variation initial data on the past light cone whose solutions form naked singularities has positive codimension (Theorem 4.1: for each element of E there is a 2-dimensional linear subspace meeting E only at that element). This is a genericity/codimension statement; the taxonomy genericity slot for this class is unresolved, so the case is filed with genericity_kind=unresolved and the mapping of codimension-positive to baire_residual is left to L1.
